meta.name: keyless-wiring-test
meta.description: For suites that assert server wiring and never run a codon. The pi passthrough provider below is not credential-enforced, so the startup self-test passes with no API keys in the environment — which is what lets these suites live in the keyless offline tier. Never autostart a run against this config: the model does not exist.
